title: Fan Cowl Latch Assembly — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of a fan cowl latch assembly and its keeper, with the cowl support arrangement that must be in place before the latch is disturbed and the record of the over-centre setting.

sections.purpose: To remove a fan cowl latch assembly and its keeper for replacement or for access to the cowl frame behind it.
sections.job_setup_note: Both fan cowls must be open and supported on their hold-open rods before any latch is removed, and the aircraft must not be moved while a latch is off. The over-centre setting must be recorded before the latch is disturbed. Two persons are needed, one at the cowl and one supporting.
sections.procedure: WARNING: OPEN AND SUPPORT BOTH FAN COWLS ON THEIR HOLD-OPEN RODS BEFORE ANY LATCH IS REMOVED. A COWL WITH ONE LATCH REMOVED CAN FALL WITHOUT WARNING. Put the safety barriers in position. Remove the electrical power and put the warning notices in position. Open both fan cowls and install both hold-open rods. Put the cowl support trestle under the cowl being worked on. Record the over-centre setting of the latch against the scale on the keeper. Release the latch hook from the keeper. Remove the washers EN17059-86 at the latch pivot and keep them if the same latch is to be refitted. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE LATCH SWING FREELY WHEN THE PIVOT BOLT IS WITHDRAWN. THE HOOK EDGE WILL MARK THE COWL SKIN. Support the latch, withdraw the pivot bolt and remove the latch assembly from the cowl. Remove the seal D7110121607820 from the latch aperture and discard it. Remove the clamp D7110124986440 from the cowl frame. Examine the latch aperture edge for cracking, for fretting and for loss of protective finish, and record any finding. Put a temporary cover over the aperture.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the aperture cover is in position and that no hardware remains in the cowl. Make sure that both hold-open rods remain installed and that the aircraft is placarded as having a latch removed. Record the removal, the over-centre setting and any finding at the aperture edge.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The keeper aperture is larger on aircraft post MOD-111337.

safety_precautions: Open and support both fan cowls on their hold-open rods before any latch is removed.
Put the cowl support trestle in position.
Placard the aircraft as having a latch removed.
